title: GeNarrative Clash
description:
Where Generative AI Meets Human Creativity: Kolkata's Ultimate Prompt Engineering Challenge Are you ready to redefine how stories are told, music is composed, and digital art is created? 
GeNarrative Clash
 is Kolkata's premier Prompt Engineering & AI Building Challenge, organized by the GeeksforGeeks Student Chapter at Techno India University. Don't worry if you are new to AI development! Before the live challenge kicks off, every participant gets access to an exclusive 
1-Hour Hands-On Masterclass on AI Development & API Integration
. Learn how to harness cutting-edge LLMs, query GenAI APIs, and leverage rapid prototyping tools so you can build a solid, production-ready product with confidence. Generative AI shouldn't replace human creators, it should supercharge them! 
GeNarrative Clash
 features an Open Track focused on building real-world solutions that assist, elevate, and support creative artists in their work. You are free to solve any real-world problem in the artistic or creative domain. title: haxfinity
description:
December 2026

Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur, Kerala

Prize Pool: Exciting prizes

Team Size: 2–4 participants Build real solutions. Solve meaningful problems. Create something that works. HAXFINITY is the 24-hour hackathon conducted as part of XTHRON '26, the annual IT fest of the Department of Computer Science, Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur. For 24 hours, students from different colleges and backgrounds will come together to identify problems, develop  software solutions, build working prototypes, and present their ideas to a panel of judges. There is no compulsory theme. Participants are free to choose a problem and develop a software solution using any suitable technology. Whether you are an experienced developer or participating in your first hackathon, HAXFINITY is a space to learn, collaborate, experiment, and build. You may work in education, healthcare, finance, agriculture, entertainment, productivity, cybersecurity, accessibility, sustainability, or any other domain. There is no fixed problem statement and no restriction on technology. Choose a problem, design a solution, build a working prototype, and surprise the judges. Build intelligent systems using machine learning, generative AI, natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems, data analysis, or any other AI-related technology. Projects will be evaluated on technical implementation, originality, usefulness, and real-world applicability. Possible areas include rural development, accessibility, mental health, financial inclusion, education, healthcare, environmental protection, and community welfare. Projects in this track will be evaluated on impact, usability, sustainability, and the effectiveness of the proposed solution. 12 December, 10:30 AM — Opening ceremony and problem-solving begins. During the day — Teams form, ideas take shape, and development begins. Throughout the event — Mentoring, technical support, checkpoints, and interaction with fellow participants. Midnight — The hackathon continues with snacks, discussions, debugging, and late-night building. 13 December, 10:32 AM — Submission deadline and code freeze. After submission — Teams prepare their final demonstrations. Final judging — Each team presents its working prototype to the judges. Closing ceremony — Winners are announced and prizes are distributed. HAXFINITY is open to students from all streams and colleges. Students from computer science, information technology, engineering, science, commerce, management, design, and other disciplines are welcome. The only requirement is that you come prepared to learn, collaborate, and create. Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous)

Santhigramam, Eranhimangad

Nilambur, Malappuram, Kerala — 679329 The campus is located in the Nilambur region of Kerala, known for its natural surroundings and teak forests. Travel and accommodation information will be shared with registered participants. Cloud credits, software benefits, and additional resources may be announced later if they are officially confirmed. title: Version Beta 9.0
description:
Get ready for Version Beta, the ultimate 36-hour hackathon organized by ISTE SC MANIT! This is your chance to break away from the ordinary and dive into an exciting world of innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving. With expert-led guidance and a dynamic environment, you’ll learn, grow, and connect with tech enthusiasts from across India. Plus, with amazing rewards and cash prizes up for grabs, this is an experience you won't want to miss! 💡 Important: Ideation Phase & Registration Process

Please note that our Registration and Ideation Phase are running simultaneously, ending on October 23rd. Since Devfolio requires every participant to register individually before forming a team on the platform, we are collecting your project ideas directly in the application form. Step 1: Prepare your team's Ideation PPT (using Google Slides, Canva, or Google Drive). Step 2: Ensure the access permissions are set to "Anyone with the link can view" (Restricted links will be disqualified). Step 3: When filling out the Devfolio application form, paste this link into the required PPT submission field. Team Leaders: Please submit the valid, working link to your presentation. Team Members: You must also fill out the application individually. You can either paste the exact same link as your team leader or type "NA" in the field. title: Innosprint2.0
description:
What We Are:

D4 Community is proud to present an exciting 
one-day hackathon hosted at Chandigarh University
, bringing together undergraduate students, budding tech enthusiasts, aspiring innovators, and problem solvers under one roof. This hackathon is all about 
building ideas into working products using Vibe Coding and Antigravity
. Instead of spending hours worrying about every line of code, participants can focus on their ideas, creativity, experimentation, and problem-solving while using AI-powered development to bring their vision to life. Individual Participation Only
 — this is a solo hackathon. Every participant will ideate, build, and present their own project. Important Note:
 This is an 
individual participation hackathon
. On the registration platform, you may see an option to add up to 
4 participants
. Please ignore this and register as an individual participant. Due to platform restrictions, we are currently unable to change the maximum participant limit from 4 to 1. Our Mission:

Our mission is simple yet profound: to challenge participants to take an idea and turn it into something real within a single day. With 
Vibe Coding using Antigravity
, participants can experiment with AI-assisted development, iterate quickly, and transform their ideas into functional prototypes. The focus isn't on how much code you can write. It's about 
what you can imagine, how you solve problems, and what you can build. What to Expect:

Expect an action-packed 
one day of ideation, vibe coding, experimentation, and building
. You don't need to spend the entire day writing code line by line. Bring an idea. Bring your creativity. Bring your curiosity. Let Antigravity handle the building with you. Health & Wellness
 : Build solutions that make healthcare, wellness, fitness, or everyday well-being simpler, smarter, and more accessible. Education & Learning
 : Create products that improve the way people learn, teach, practice, collaborate, or access educational resources. Productivity & Lifestyle
 : Build tools that help people manage their time, work, tasks, routines, finances, or everyday activities more effectively. Social Impact
 : Use technology to address problems faced by communities, individuals, or society and create solutions that can make a meaningful difference. Business & Innovation
 : Build innovative products, platforms, or tools that solve business problems, improve existing experiences, or create new opportunities. Entertainment & Creativity
 : Build something fun, interactive, creative, or completely unexpected. Explore new ways to entertain, create, and engage. Open Theme
 : Have an idea that doesn't fit into any of the above? That's completely fine. Build 
anything you want
. If you can imagine it, you can build it. Why Join Us:

Join us to experience a completely different way of building products. Sharpen your problem-solving skills, experiment with 
Vibe Coding
, learn how to work with AI-assisted development, and turn an idea into a working prototype — 
all in a single day. Whether you're already familiar with AI-powered development or you're trying it for the first time, this hackathon is an opportunity to 
learn by building
. No team. No waiting for teammates. No complicated setup. Just you, your idea, Antigravity, and one day to build. Stay Tuned:

title: TUM Blockchain & AI Hackathon
description: AI agents are starting to act on their own: booking, negotiating, paying. The payment rails for that don't fully exist yet. This hackathon is about building the infrastructure and applications that let autonomous agents transact safely and instantly on-chain. TUM Blockchain Club has brought together 3,000+ builders, researchers and founders over the last four years, running Europe's largest student-led Web3 event. This year the hackathon sits inside TBC26: three days, two venues, one community, with the main conference and Bundesblock's Digital Assets Day running alongside. title: Arkiv: Global Tour Stop 🌍
description:
A special edition on the road to Devcon 8 Mumbai. Ten days to build on Arkiv, the Web3 database. Build on 
Arkiv
, the Web3 database, around one theme: 
CROPS
, the Ethereum Foundation's mandate that Ethereum stay 
c
ensorship resistant, 
o
pen source, 
p
rivate and 
s
ecure. Ten days, fully online, open to builders everywhere. The challenge opens live at Network School Astana during the Network State Conference on 
9 October
 and closes on 
18 October
. Five winners get a Devcon 8 ticket on top of their prize. Build anything useful and usable for the ecosystem: a dApp, a library, an SDK, a devtool, a CLI, an indexer, a dataset, an agent, a browser extension or more. Four CROPS tracks are open to everyone, and the Best Indian Use Case track rewards a real-world application that people in India can use. Pick 
one or more tracks
 when you submit: the four CROPS pillars and Best Indian Use Case. All projects are scored on four criteria, 25 points each. The first one depends on the track and is scored for each track you enter: Before scoring, every project must pass the gates: a public deployment judges can open without asking for access (libraries, CLIs and datasets too), reproducible steps, a public MIT repo, 
/arkiv/schema.md
, 
/arkiv/friction.md
, the wallet addresses that create your Arkiv entities on Tiramisu, a demo video of 3 minutes or less, every required question on the submission form answered, and work built between 9 and 18 October. Disclose any pre-existing work with its baseline commit SHA. A project needs at least 50/100 to win. Disqualified:
 plagiarised work; no meaningful Arkiv use (SDK installed but never queried, or a conventional database app with Arkiv branding); private keys, secrets or real personal data stored in Arkiv, in plaintext or hashed (use synthetic data); malicious code; no working app; late entries. At the deadline we record your repo's commit SHA and judge that commit. Rewriting history after the deadline disqualifies the entry. Keep your deployment up until 23 October. . That repo is the only canonical source: if anything here differs, the repo applies. A special edition on the road to Devcon 8 Mumbai. Ten days to build on Arkiv, the Web3 database. Build on

title: HACK WITH GDG S4
description:
Hack With GDG S4
 is the fourth season of the flagship hackathon organized by 
Google Developer Groups – KSR College of Engineering (GDG KSRCE)
. The event brings together developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful solutions through technology. Due to unforeseen circumstances, 
Hack With GDG S4 has been postponed
. The revised dates for the hackathon will be announced soon. Participants are requested to follow our official communication channels for updates regarding the new schedule, submission deadlines, and other event-related announcements. Participants will submit their 
project idea in PPT/PDF format
 for evaluation. Teams will be evaluated based on their problem statement, proposed solution, innovation, feasibility, and potential impact. A working prototype is not mandatory at this stage, but prior technical work may be considered an advantage. Selected teams will advance to the offline hackathon. Selected teams will participate in a 
36-hour offline hackathon
, where they will build and demonstrate their solutions on-site. Hack With GDG S4 welcomes participants across different skill levels and backgrounds. Both 
beginners and experienced participants

Open Innovation

title: Hack For Tomorrow 2026
description: The flagship 24-hour collegiate hackathon of Excel, bringing together top student developers from across India to solve high-impact, real-world engineering challenges. Organized under the aegis of Govt. Model Engineering College (MEC), Kochi and its annual techno-managerial fest Excel, Hack For Tomorrow provides an inclusive and collaborative platform for developers of all skill levels. Over 24 continuous hours, participants work alongside seasoned industry mentors and alumni engineers to conceptualize, architect, and ship functional technical prototypes in an energetic offline environment.
